proposal.title: Heredity Thresholds and Stoichiometric Conditions in Prebiotic Chemical Systems
proposal.summary: This update revises the analysis of heredity thresholds by incorporating concepts of information fidelity loss from digital data augmentation (as a heuristic for chemical replicator fidelity) and thermodynamic constraints on memory persistence. The synthesis confirms that compositional stability depends on both the stoichiometric coupling of reaction networks and the thermodynamic cost of erasing information, which limits the durability of any inherited state.
